label: Why generalize
subgoals: Note that a full-state clause excludes only one state
Look for a sub-cube with fewer literals
Require initiation and relative inductiveness of the smaller cube

label: Dropping a literal
subgoals: Form the cube with one literal removed
Check that it contains no initial state
Check that no state of F outside it has a transition into it

label: MIC and unsat cores
subgoals: Drop the literals absent from the unsat core
Try dropping each remaining literal with one SAT call
Block counterexamples to generalization before retrying a drop
